value.rationale: Use the scoped relation specification because its authorization, restriction, and recipient-link frames preserve the distinctions needed by the frozen consumer: operative clauses versus definitions, direct recipients versus affiliate personnel reached through an access condition, and bounded role exceptions versus consent, compulsion, or recipient-unspecified exceptions. The compiler performs local deontic and action analysis, resolves representative definitions when referenced, emits only source-supported canonical roles, and leaves unresolved fields null instead of copying entire role domains or treating missing evidence as prohibition.
